explanation: Merged main (#30, #31, #34, #32, #33) into the query-wire branch. From this branch: queryWire.test.ts pins the published query-index names and row layouts, round-trips every row codec, checks trackEntry against the qcFlags low-power rule and proves the client reads where the generator writes; resultBars.test.tsx drops its client-only cardGlobalName pin. From main: From this branch: csv.test.ts pins the CSV seam (escaping table, formula guard, BOM/CRLF, provenance columns), csvDownload.ts is the shared reader for a mocked downloadFile, csvDialog.test.tsx covers the HypoMap dialog download, and the library, gene-list, gene and circadian export tests read files through that helper. From main: hypomapCodetection, hypomapCoexpression and hypomapMetrics tests cover the co-detection client, expressionSurvey and expressionSurveyLoad tests the survey derivation and load lifecycle, and sourceJson tests the expression-source reader.
